sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "organization" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "license_no" TEXT NULL, "license_valid_until" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "site" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id), "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "customer" TEXT NULL, "earthing_system" TEXT NULL, "u0_volts" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_user" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id), "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("role" IN ('ADMIN', 'LEAD', 'ENGINEER', 'VIEWER')), "safety_group" TEXT NULL CHECK("safety_group" IN ('I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V')), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "measurement_session" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id), "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES site (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "engineer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES app_user (id), "ambient_temp_c" REAL NULL, "humidity_pct" REAL NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "closed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "node" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id), "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES site (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "panel_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES node (id), "state" TEXT NULL, "attrs" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "verified" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("verified" IN (0, 1)), "x" REAL NULL, "y" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "instrument" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id), "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "serial_no" TEXT NOT NULL, "verification_cert_no" TEXT NULL, "verified_until" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "measurement" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id), "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES measurement_session (id), "node_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES node (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "instrument_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES instrument (id), "values" TEXT NOT NULL, "entered_via" TEXT NOT NULL, "verdict" TEXT NOT NULL, "norm_id" TEXT NULL, "norm_set_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "eval_detail" TEXT NOT NULL, "supersedes_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES measurement (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER measurement_append_only_update BEFORE UPDATE ON measurement BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'append_only: measurement');END
CREATE TRIGGER measurement_append_only_delete BEFORE DELETE ON measurement BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'append_only: measurement');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id), "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES app_user (id), "public_key_ed25519" TEXT NOT NULL, "sig_alg" TEXT NOT NULL, "registered_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "revoked_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "protocol" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id), "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES measurement_session (id), "number" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "pdf_sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "signed_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES app_user (id), "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES device (id), "signature" TEXT NOT NULL, "sig_alg" TEXT NOT NULL, "qr_token" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("org_id", "number"));
CREATE TRIGGER protocol_append_only_update BEFORE UPDATE ON protocol BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'append_only: protocol');END
CREATE TRIGGER protocol_append_only_delete BEFORE DELETE ON protocol BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'append_only: protocol');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "protocol_document" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id), "protocol_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES protocol (id), "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "pdf" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER protocol_document_append_only_update BEFORE UPDATE ON protocol_document BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'append_only: protocol_document');END
CREATE TRIGGER protocol_document_append_only_delete BEFORE DELETE ON protocol_document BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'append_only: protocol_document');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_event" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id), "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES device (id), "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "prev_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_hash" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES app_user (id), "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NULL, "payload_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_sig" TEXT NOT NULL, "sig_alg" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("device_id", "seq"));
CREATE TRIGGER audit_event_append_only_update BEFORE UPDATE ON audit_event BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'append_only: audit_event');END
CREATE TRIGGER audit_event_append_only_delete BEFORE DELETE ON audit_event BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'append_only: audit_event');END
CREATE INDEX node_site_idx ON node (site_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "edge" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id), "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES site (id), "a_node_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES node (id), "b_node_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES node (id), "conductors" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX edge_site_idx ON edge (site_id)
CREATE INDEX measurement_session_idx ON measurement (session_id)
CREATE INDEX audit_event_entity_idx ON audit_event (entity_id)

CREATE TRIGGER organization_outbox_ins AFTER INSERT ON organization WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM local_pref WHERE "key" = 'sync.applying') BEGIN INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_outbox (table_name, row_id, op_id) VALUES ('organization', NEW.id, lower(hex(randomblob(16))));END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "isolation_plan" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id), "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "site_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES site (id), "target_node_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "solver_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "graph_snapshot_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "steps" TEXT NOT NULL, "warnings" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'APPROVED', 'EXECUTED', 'CANCELLED', 'STALE')), "approved_by" TEXT NULL REFERENCES app_user (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER isolation_plan_outbox_ins AFTER INSERT ON isolation_plan WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM local_pref WHERE "key" = 'sync.applying') BEGIN INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_outbox (table_name, row_id, op_id) VALUES ('isolation_plan', NEW.id, lower(hex(randomblob(16))));END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "org_setting" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id), "k_corr" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0 CHECK("k_corr" > 0.0 AND "k_corr" <= 1.0), "margin_pct" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0 CHECK("margin_pct" BETWEEN 0.0 AND 50.0), "active_norm_set_version" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("org_id"));
